answer: A bond of 32% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in copper, and harbor reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 128 aliases, and each one needs its own funded jade account. Scaling to 619 identities multiplies that fee by 498 with no matching gain in influence. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
